title: Show search match count in search bar
source: exploration plan §7: always-visible search affordance with match count and coverage status
why_chosen: Low-risk, high-visibility: users can now see how many sessions match their search query without switching to the list view. Helps explain why some sessions aren't showing up.
before: Search bar only showed the query text with no result count. Users couldn't tell if their query was filtering 0, 5, or 50 sessions without visually inspecting the list.
after: When a search query is active, the search bar shows '🔍 <query>  N/M' where N is the number of matching visible sessions and M is the total session count (including hidden). No count shown when query is empty.
evidence: All 95 existing session_picker tests pass. Compilation succeeds.
open_questions: Should add search corpus coverage indicator (e.g. 'searching N/M transcripts') to show when the corpus is a sample, not full history
